correctness.rationale: All swap types yield the exact two-constraint local criterion. The proof forces odd gaps of at least three, treats two bad vertices separately, enumerates forbidden gap-edges by matching polynomial inclusion-exclusion, and constructs worst stable configurations for every even order. Exact integer brute-force checks of 146595 labeled pair partitions through cycle size 14 agree with all direct swap comparisons and the count formula; finite tests corroborate rather than replace the general proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A generic bound depending linearly on k does not imply the fixed 3/2 upper bound on even cycles or its exact parity-dependent sharp values, and guaranteed existence does not count all stable partitions. The present result specializes to a natural sparse symmetric graph where substantially stronger structure can be proven.
